title: andropogon saccharoides subvar. perforatus
intro: Andropogon saccharoides subvar. perforatus, commonly known as Buffalo Grass, is a perennial grass species native to North America, characterized by its dense growth habit and tolerance to drought. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Buffalo Grass include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Buffalo Grass include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
